'''Microfilm''' was a method of storing information. Usually, the information transcribed on microfilm was unreadable by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] eye, but [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were able to [[Magnify Senses|magnify their senses]] were able to read it.<ref name="RPG" />
